title: Save On Select Sony Alpha Cameras This Week
summary: Ready to buy a new piece of gear? Good news and great timing – Sony just dropped some of the biggest savings of the year.
body_markdown:

At $500 off, this is genuinely one of the best values in Sony's entire lineup right now.
